inspiration: Texture sets are a colour, normal and height triple per material (name.jpg, name_n.png, name_d.png); the height map is greyscale (abyssal_d.png is colour type 0): a three-map PBR set gives bump and parallax depth to ground and walls.
Flow maps drive animated lava and caustics (lava_flow_map.png, caustics_map.jpg): a flow texture scrolled over a base is a cheap animated lava or water look.
Leaves come as one template with a colour family (orange, red, yellow tops and sides) and worn or willow variants: one leaf setup, several palettes and wear states.
Organic cave floor uses a dedicated organic set (abyssal_2_*, with normal and height maps): a tiled organic pattern is a clear alternative to rock tile floors.
Lighting is data-driven: lights.json, sky_presets.json and daylight_cycle per environment; a light list and sky preset per zone reuse one renderer.
Water is data-driven too (water_types.json, environments.json): one water shader serves many zones with different data.
Fur comes as a short-hair colour and normal set (fur.jpg, fur_n.png): a fur or shell layer on a base mesh is a common technique (technique only; no mesh in repo).

briefs.label: Abyssal cave floor (our label)
briefs.why: An organic tiled floor with a dedicated height map (abyssal_d.png greyscale) reads as alien ground; image not viewed, so the mood is inferred from the file names and formats.
briefs.keep: organic tile pattern; height-driven bump; cool palette
briefs.change: our own pattern shapes; different palette (warm or ash); our own edge treatment

briefs.label: Lava flow surface (our label)
briefs.why: Separate lava texture set plus a flow map (lava_flow_map.png) gives moving molten ground; image not viewed.
briefs.keep: flow-map scroll over a base; glow on cracks; three lava tones
briefs.change: our own crack pattern; different glow colour; a different flow direction rule

briefs.label: Caustic water floor (our label)
briefs.why: A caustic map texture gives light patterns on a water floor; the source is CC0 so it is class A. Image not viewed.
briefs.keep: caustic light overlay; slow scroll; shallow water tint
briefs.change: our own caustic shapes; different scale; warmer water colour

briefs.label: Organic leaf canopy (our label)
briefs.why: A leaf template with colour variants (orange, red, yellow) and a diseased variant gives seasonal and corrupted foliage; image not viewed.
briefs.keep: one template, several palettes; a diseased variant with a sick colour
briefs.change: our own leaf shape; different season palette; a different disease look

briefs.label: Shaggy hide (our label)
briefs.why: A short-fur colour and normal set (fur.jpg, fur_n.png) suggests a hairy creature skin for a mob; image not viewed.
briefs.keep: normal-mapped fur; a dark base with lighter tips
briefs.change: our own fur length; different tip colour; a different hide pattern
